name: Hanae Okabe
card: Hanae Okabe, 63, human, owner and head cook of Kettle & Ladle Noodle Bar in Old Town. Short, wiry, grey bun, sleeves pushed up, forearms burned and scarred from forty years at the stove. Gruff, fair and secretly soft; scolds fondly, never wastes food, treats Riko like a niece and does not say so. Present when the noodle bar is open, though she often leaves the floor to Riko and keeps to the kitchen.
when: Most days at the bar, often out on errands in the early evening

name: Ezra Quill
card: Ezra Quill, 68, human, owner of Tideglass Books in Old Town. Tall, stooped, white beard, half-moon glasses on a cord, cardigan with leather elbow patches. Soft-spoken, wry, recommends books by looking at a person for a long moment; naps in the back room. Fond of Mara and will not say so. Knows a rumor about every old book in the shop.
when: Shop hours, often in the back room with a cup of tea
